senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. גָּדַר a. עָדַד)to strip.—Part. pass. עָדוּר; f. עֲדוּרָה, v. אָדַר.
to pluck, clear (of weeds); to hoe; to pick (figs, cmp. אָרָה); [b. h. also: to sift an army, to discharge the unfit &c., to muster out, v.
units: <cite ref="I Chronicles 12:34">I Chr. XII, 34</cite>; <cite ref="I Chronicles 12:39">39</cite>].

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:4">Neg. II, 4</cite>; Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 3, ch. IV <he>כעוֹדֵר</he> in the position of one hoeing; <he>כעודר בבית הסתרים</he> the position of one hoeing is required for the examination of the posteriors.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 2:14">Tosef. Maasr. II, 14</cite> <he>פועלים שהיו עוֹדְרִין בתאנים</he> laborers engaged in picking figs; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 89b">B. Mets. 89ᵇ</cite> (Ar. <he>אורין</he>, v. <cite ref="A03013"><he>אָרָה</he></cite>).
Ib. לַעֲדוֹר ולקשקש וכ׳ Rashi (ed. לעַדֵּר, Pi.) to hoe and to cover up the roots of olive trees.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:19">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>עוֹדְרֵי ירקות</he> engaged in thinning vegetables (cmp. <cite ref="D00841"><he>דָּלַל</he></cite>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 2:13">Tosef. Maasr. II, 13</cite> <he>מְעַדְּרִין בשדה</he> engaged in hoeing a field.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> better is he who rents one field <he>ומזבלה ומְעַדְּרָהּ וכ׳</he> and manures and hoes it &c. Y. Maasr. III, end, 51ᵃ <he>והוא שעי׳ רובה</he> provided he broke the ground of the larger portion of the court; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 1:3">Tosef. Makhsh. I, 3</cite> <he>מעודר</he>, ed. Zuck. <he>מעודרון</he>, v. <cite ref="P00198"><he>עוּד</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be hoed, to be prepared for tillage. Y. l. c. והיא שתהא נעדרת provided the ground of the court has been broken (before sowing). Ib. 50ᵈ bot. חצר שהיא נעדרת ונזרעת R. S. to Maasr. III, 9 (ed. only נעדרת) a court which has been hoed up and planted with seeds; a. e.
